name: postmortem
description: The audit family: evidence-grounded postmortems of finished work on three independent axes (evidence, lens, rendering), where a lens is one markdown file picking the sections so a repo adds its own without forking, optionally with figures and charts, plus a browsable index, a test-suite audit (does each green test still mean anything), a controls audit (census and live-fire over hooks, validators, and reminders), and the adversarial-verify primitive with its control-builder agent that the audits dispatch to
